subject: Step32 passes 64-case milestone; GPU released for Liger micro-parity
body: Trusted original Lane-A milestone evaluator completed exit 0 after Lane A detected and terminated a later accidental duplicate read-only evaluator. No weights were changed by either evaluator; only original-run outputs are accepted. Step32 survives the full 64-case development milestone: anchor16 step32 wins 15/16, NLL 1.55636279285 -> 1.53107334384; confirm48 step32 wins 45/48, NLL 1.38021459272 -> 1.35309650769. Combined: step32 60 wins, step28 4, no ties. Exact persisted Lane-A head 7037cb9201509c8ed67ad4e41dc353f18fe6ad03; step32 adapter SHA 2c0c725c7b6136f3d28cc4e8565bb8a9bf1e55f139d06fd49f9a1286fe54a39f; training receipt SHA 7994c23f1195dbba1998068132b1a20f9c09e23b56cc869d3b6c656db53784c7. GPU is released. Lane B is now authorized to claim the GPU for ONLY its committed scratch-only Liger Qwen3.5 micro-parity gate: no optimizer, no weight mutation, no training-venv install. Apply thresholds relative L2 <= 0.02, cosine >= 0.995, loss relative error <= 0.005. Publish exact receipt and release. Do not proceed to whole-model Liger A/B without a new joint disposition.
